notes.title: Patch 3 (v1.0.3.0) Revision Notes
notes.content:
Big thanks to FordGT90Concept on Discord for doing a ton of wonderfully detailed playtesting recently AND for programming a tool capable of reading the entire game, resulting in finding a few deeply hidden issues that are now fixed.

UI/functionality 
-Added an Epilespy warning screen before the main menu 
-When Real-time stream is turned OFF, brain-scan loading animation is disabled entirely
-To unlock stream meta-endings, players now must find a canon stream ending 

Stream Content (SPOILERS!)
-Fixed a potential loop (may see the same command multiple times) during the briefing.
-Fixed an issue where, in certain scenarios, dragging a certain somebody's corpse to a security door would incorrectly indicate that Jenkins leaves his pack behind.
-Fixed some wonkiness in the text surrounding the path where you shoot Uchida in the head at the Computer Core.
-Fixed a potential (and rare) "Re2conn1ect" issue at the very end within the control room that may have appeared alongside your intended "Re2conn1ect" command.
-Fixed a bug in the control room. If you enter with Uchida, this could sometimes generate a scene that shouldn't be there along with your intended scene (they would display back to back).
-Fixed the "kick lancaster off the team" command to better reflect how the commands work in Jenkins' head, and also refined/cut this scene down.
Some clean-up to the grenade response scenes in the vent shaft.
-Further polish and cutting of the Break Room scenes. In particular, the post-grenade path.
-Big polish/cuts/logic fixing to the "Knock" command when going through the corridors directly.
-Fixed a small handful of lines/paragraphs situated directly before images that were being cut off by the system (in particular, the defector images).
-Fixed one of the ~20 potential endings in the control room that was unreachable due to a variable issue.
-Streamlined some Seeker command logic w/ the defectors in the corridor.
-Major polish to the "Fi2nd th1e h21eat exch2ange1rs" scene following the defectors.
-The opening Golden Man scene now references two particularly weird incidents that may have occurred at Hakuba because of Seeker commands.
-To fix a hidden ending bug without resetting the ending count, there is now a new scene during the briefing after you uncover the mysterious VR Deck that's underneath the white sheet.

notes.title: v1.0.2.0 Revision Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Whispers From The Rift v1.0.2.0 Revision Notes[/h2]

Thank-you to everyone who has told us about bugs and issues.

[u]UI/functionality [/u]
-Fixed issue where if real-time mode was OFF, some very large chapters would be cut off early.
-Fixed two Steam achievements not firing at the correct spot ( "Reach the computer core...." and “Soltz Down”)
-Fixed issue where the buttons at the top would cease to re-enable when a Stream report (news report) button was created.
-Fixed issue of erroneous spaces after italicized text
-Fixed issue of the “real-time stream” setting not properly restoring upon reloading and resuming the stream
-Added a quick scroll to auto-show “Continue” after an error, even when real-time stream is OFF
-Fixed Restart button not working 
-Fixed issue of the “-” character appearing erroneously as a square

[u]Stream Content (WARNING!  SPOILERS!)[/u]
-Improved explanation in the "I am the Seeker" choice & polished "Stan21d and lea2ve this pla1ce" w/ Setharan.
-Fixed "Where are we?" in Setharan scene being a duplicate of the "Go to Sleep" scene.
-It now explains the 'Success only comes through cooperation' note at the beginning of the mission much more clearly.
-Improvements to when you first crawl inside the vent shaft + moved where the image is placed + removed an erroneous mention of Soltz in this scene.
-Greater clarity about the worm device when Jenkins shoots Uchida in the leg.
-Logic bug: related to asking Uchida if he stole the original weapon plans.
-Logic bug: related to when you demand an apology from Soltz at Hakuba. Made major edits here to make things clearer + the response now depends more on previous commands.
-Logic bug: In one instance of the doppelganger encounter, there was some duplicated text.
-Logic bug: If you fell asleep in the snow outside Hakuba, the three wakeup scenes w/ Soltz, Wheats or Lancaster now properly reference this choice.
-Logic bug: There is a particular scene at the beginning of the mission w/ wolves. I addressed the fact they haven't been native to Japan for over a century.
-Logic bug: Fixed potential doubling up of the last scene (you may have seen two "Rec2onnec1t") in the path where you push a certain somebody to do something horrible while you're inside the vents and then enter the weapon control room w/out Uchida.
-Logic bug: Fixed if you go to the control room without Uchida, you may have seen an erroneous "Th2e Resul1t" command (about the San Andreas fault rupturing) along with your intended ending.
-Pop-up description of SUSANOO significantly improved.
-Many typos and other minor blips fixed throughout the text.
